links.reported_relation: registerAgents should verify the caller is the designated operator; without this check an unauthorized entity can register the instance, enabling the griefing that causes Bob's registration to fail.
The already-registered check in ServiceRegistry::registerAgents can be exploited to prevent a legitimate instance from being registered to a valid service.
Alice registers Bob's instance to her fake service, after which the instance cannot be unbonded, so Bob's later registration fails.
